div.head: HISTORY OF THE DECLINE AND FALL OF THE ROMAN EMPIRE
1782 (Written), 1845 (Revised)
div.p: There are two Project Gutenberg sets of the complete "History Of The Decline And Fall Of The Roman Empire" by Edward Gibbon: the 1996 ASCII text only edition (PG #731-736) has the advantage of including all the foonotes by Gibbon and others; the 1997 edition (PG #890-895)in the Latin-1 character set was provided at that time only in html format and footnotes were not included in the first five volumes of this set.

p.hi: NOTE: The huge size of this ebook makes for long delays in response time when trying to open the individual chapters in this index. Often it is more efficient to
and then use its index at the top of the file.
